019package org.apache.bcel.generic;
020
021import org.apache.bcel.Const;
022
023/**
024 * Super class for the x2y family of instructions.
025 */
026public abstract class ConversionInstruction extends Instruction implements TypedInstruction, StackProducer, StackConsumer {
027
028    /**
029     * Empty constructor needed for Instruction.readInstruction. Not to be used otherwise.
030     */
031    ConversionInstruction() {
032    }
033
034    /**
035     * @param opcode opcode of instruction
036     */
037    protected ConversionInstruction(final short opcode) {
038        super(opcode, (short) 1);
039    }
040
041    /**
042     * @return type associated with the instruction
043     */
044    @Override
045    public Type getType(final ConstantPoolGen cp) {
046        final short opcode = super.getOpcode();
047        switch (opcode) {
048        case Const.D2I:
049        case Const.F2I:
050        case Const.L2I:
051            return Type.INT;
052        case Const.D2F:
053        case Const.I2F:
054        case Const.L2F:
055            return Type.FLOAT;
056        case Const.D2L:
057        case Const.F2L:
058        case Const.I2L:
059            return Type.LONG;
060        case Const.F2D:
061        case Const.I2D:
062        case Const.L2D:
063            return Type.DOUBLE;
064        case Const.I2B:
065            return Type.BYTE;
066        case Const.I2C:
067            return Type.CHAR;
068        case Const.I2S:
069            return Type.SHORT;
070        default: // Never reached
071            throw new ClassGenException("Unknown type " + opcode);
072        }
073    }
074}
